description: Model profiles shared by all three agents.
'default' names the profile used when no --profile (or --local / --openai) flag picks one.
Precedence: --model / --base-url, then the environment variables named by model_env /
base_url_env, then (with model_auto) the model loaded on the server (LM Studio), then the
With model_auto, the profile uses whichever model is loaded on the server and may omit model;
then, with nothing loaded, the run stops and says so instead of making the server load one.
The key comes from the variable named by api_key_env; api_key is only a fallback for
servers that need no real key.
error_hints: "openai" gives OpenAI-specific advice (key, quota, billing) when a request
fails; without it, errors point at the server and the model instead.
max_tokens: the most tokens one reply may use, thinking included: a reasoning model spends
thousands thinking before it answers. It applies to every model call, the three agents' and the
pull request gate's quiz writer, so a model stuck thinking stops there with a clear message.
Without it, the server's own limit applies.
checker: a separate answer checker for the pull request gate, used when QUIZ_VERIFY_PROFILE in
gatekeepers/pr/settings.json names it. It must reason at least as well as the quiz writer: a
model that answers without thinking (qwen3-coder-next) confirmed a wrong answer key every time.
It names its model, so LM Studio loads it beside the writer's; its timeout leaves room for that.
